publisher: 北海道旅客鉄道株式会社
title: 鉄道・きっぷ
notes: Official entry point. It states that timetable search is provided by Kotsu Shimbunsha. Suitable for discovering line/train views, not evidence of an all-year inventory.

publisher: 北海道旅客鉄道株式会社 / 株式会社交通新聞社
title: ［特急］すずらん・北斗（札幌―室蘭・東室蘭・函館）上り
notes: Public table exposes train numbers, train names, operating-day labels and station departure/arrival rows. Portal cautions that data may change and is not always current. A single line view does not establish the operator-wide inventory.

publisher: 北海道旅客鉄道株式会社 / 株式会社交通新聞社
title: 時刻検索 ご利用にあたって
notes: Defines coverage as JR Hokkaido, Tohoku Shinkansen and South Hokkaido Railway; says monthly data normally covers through the month after next. No permission for bulk reuse was identified.

publisher: 東日本旅客鉄道株式会社
title: 時刻表
notes: Official station and train timetable portal. Month-specific train pages can expose calls and times, but the landing page is not a limited-express inventory and does not prove all-year completeness.

publisher: 東海旅客鉄道株式会社
title: アクセス検索
notes: Official page says JR Central conventional lines are covered, next-month data is loaded monthly, and train names lead to a train timetable. Query-oriented coverage does not provide a complete operator inventory.

publisher: 東海旅客鉄道株式会社
title: 各駅の時刻表
notes: Lists line coverage and states conventional-line pages mirror station postings. During research the page reported partial service unavailability. It cannot establish complete current trip calendars by itself.

publisher: 西日本旅客鉄道株式会社 / 株式会社交通新聞社
title: JRおでかけネット 時刻表
notes: Train pages explicitly prohibit unauthorized reproduction, copying, and processing into any medium. Use only to verify facts and record citations; do not build or commit a scraper-derived bulk dataset.

publisher: 西日本旅客鉄道株式会社 / 株式会社交通新聞社
title: 特急 サンダーバード1号 敦賀行 列車時刻表
notes: Exact public candidate: train 4001M, limited express Thunderbird 1, daily label, all calls and pass rows, with arrival/departure times for every passenger stop. Candidate metadata only is staged; timetable data must not be redistributed from this page.

publisher: 四国旅客鉄道株式会社
title: 駅・鉄道情報
notes: Official entry point for station departure timetables, train formations and special-train notices. Station views alone do not prove complete trips or calendars; JR West through-train pages are a separate corroborating source.

publisher: 四国旅客鉄道株式会社
title: JR四国サイト利用規約
notes: The HTML points to the full terms PDF. No timetable-data redistribution grant was identified during this inventory.

publisher: 九州旅客鉄道株式会社 / 株式会社交通新聞社
title: JR九州 駅別時刻表
notes: Official station timetable system. Search results state that the system uses Kotsu Shimbunsha JR Timetable data. It is useful for date checks but is not an operator-wide inventory export.

publisher: 九州旅客鉄道株式会社
title: 特急ゆふいんの森
notes: Official table publishes six train numbers and every passenger stop with one displayed time per stop. Intermediate arrival times are not published. Calendar dates are image-coded and require deterministic image extraction plus review; the page itself warns dates may change and does not prove all-year completeness.

publisher: 九州旅客鉄道株式会社
title: 鉄道・きっぷの予約・旅行
notes: Current operational notice layer, separate from the published base timetable. Dynamic notices must be modeled as planned/actual operation evidence and must not silently overwrite the base timetable.

publisher: 九州旅客鉄道株式会社
title: 2026年7月～9月 臨時列車運転計画・D&S列車運転日
notes: Official calendar source for July-September plans. Later revisions and disruption notices take precedence for affected dates. Never extend its calendars beyond the explicitly printed period.

publisher: 国立国会図書館
title: 時刻表（リサーチ・ナビ）
notes: Authoritative holdings guide: original JR/JTB predecessors, Meiji-Taisho reprints, wartime and immediate-postwar reprints, WARP, and specialist libraries. It proves source availability/holdings, not the timetable facts inside each issue.

publisher: 国立国会図書館
title: 鉄道が変えたコト・モノ 第1章 時間感覚
notes: Supports month/year-level milestones: limited express service began Shinbashi-Shimonoseki in 1912; limited expresses were absent during wartime/immediate postwar; Heiwa restored Tokyo-Osaka service in 1949. It does not provide exact daily boundaries or complete stop/times.

publisher: 鉄道博物館
title: 鉄道開業150年記念企画展『鉄道と旅』プレス資料
notes: States that Japan's first special express began Shinbashi-Shimonoseki service in June 1912. It does not establish the exact day or full timetable.

publisher: 昭和館 / 厚生労働省
title: 第24回昭和館運営有識者会議 資料
notes: Records that Tsubame ended in October 1943, Fuji was the last named limited express and ended in April 1944, and Heiwa restored limited express service around 1949. Month precision only for the zero-service boundaries.

publisher: 昭和館
title: 資料紹介 戦後復興への希望をのせて 特急列車の復活
notes: States that limited express service, abolished during the war, returned as Heiwa on Tokyo-Osaka in September 1949. It does not state the exact day in the article.

publisher: 鉄道博物館
title: さようなら平成・新元号制定記念 大正／昭和／平成 改元時の鉄道資料ミニ展示
archive_locator: page 1, lines describing the displayed Shinbashi-Shimonoseki timetable
notes: Official museum notice states that the first special express operated on 1912-06-15 and identifies the displayed Shinbashi-Shimonoseki timetable as revised on that date. It verifies the start date and endpoints, not the complete calls, times, train number or calendar.
